limitations: Evidence quality varies by provider: some sites or external/storefront pages were inaccessible during this run; those candidates are marked with gaps or ineligible rather than inferred as eligible.
Review ratings and counts are included only when explicitly observed; none were reliably captured in the supplied evidence.
Self-reported catalog, tour, or usage claims are kept as provider claims and are not treated as independently corroborated success metrics.
The research is a design/conversion landscape, not a ranking or assessment of business success.

message: Compiled 26 distinct candidates, deduplicating overlapping brand records. Candidates with unavailable or insufficient fetched evidence are marked ineligible or carry explicit gaps; ratings/counts are null unless directly observed.
